name: Pal Dhaba
why_it_matters: Run by Gurmeet Singh Pal, one of the oldest dhabas around Hathi Gate. Specialises in the meat cuts most restaurants skip — paya, magaz, kaleji — slow-cooked overnight. Thirty-rupee chairs, fifty-rupee plates, hundred-year recipes.
insider_tip: Paya runs out by 2pm — this is a breakfast-to-late-lunch destination, not a dinner one. Ask for the magaz only if you've eaten brain curry before; it's not a starter dish.
signature_address: Pal Da Dhaba, Katra Moti Ram, near Hathi Gate, Amritsar 143006

name: All India Famous Amritsari Kulcha
why_it_matters: About 3km from Amritsar Railway Station, the kulcha shop where the dough is folded seven times before stuffing — visible from the open kitchen at the front. Two kulchas to a plate, loaded with butter, served with a tangy onion-chole side. The name is local marketing; the queue isn't.
insider_tip: Park on Race Course Road and walk in — Maqbool Road is single-lane chaos at lunch. Eat hot; the seven layers stay crisp for about ten minutes.
signature_address: Maqbool Road, near Race Course Road crossing, Amritsar 143104

name: Lubhaya Ram Aam Papad and Dry Fruit
why_it_matters: A Hall Bazaar institution — the original aam-papad shop opposite RS Tower, near Partition Museum. Sticky mango sheets stacked in glass jars; takeaway-only, no seating, no menu. The shop your grandmother brought back from Amritsar trips before Amritsar trips were a thing.
insider_tip: Aam papad is sold by weight — 100g is enough to test, 500g is the standard gift box. Combine the trip with the Partition Museum next door.
signature_address: Chowk Bijli, opposite RS Tower, near Partition Museum, Hall Bazaar, Amritsar 143006

name: Giani Tea Stall
why_it_matters: Run by Gurmit Singh on Cooper Road for decades — a footpath chai stall that's become a known stop on Amritsar food walks. Chai brewed in giant battered kettles, kachoris fried fresh in ghee. Cash-only; the bench is the dining hall.
insider_tip: Mornings before 9am are the cleanest order — the kachoris come out of the kadhai every 20 minutes. By afternoon they sit; ask if they're rebuying a fresh round before you order.
signature_address: Cooper Road, Maharaja Ranjit Singh Nagar, near Company Bagh, Amritsar 143001

name: Mahajan Chicken House
why_it_matters: Mall Road's main meat-and-tandoor address — the signage says 'Since 1999' and the recipe roster has barely shifted. Family-run, cash-and-card both, the working Amritsari's order for a half-tandoori-and-roti dinner.
insider_tip: The kaleji (chicken liver) here is sleeper good — half-plate as starter, then move to the tandoori. Avoid the Chinese page.
signature_address: Mall Road, near GNDU Junction, Amritsar 143001
